whetstone-apply.name: Whetstone: apply
whetstone-apply.description: Fixes, rejects, defers or escalates each actionable finding within the PR's files, runs the checks, and records the decisions.
whetstone-apply.author: Kirill Andriychuk

whetstone-core.name: Whetstone: core
whetstone-core.description: Schemas for the loop's module contracts and the deterministic checker that validates them, applies fallbacks for switched-off modules, and commits each round.
whetstone-core.author: Kirill Andriychuk

whetstone-review.name: Whetstone: review
whetstone-review.description: Instructions that turn a pr-review-toolkit review into findings.json (cc-review Finding format).
whetstone-review.author: Kirill Andriychuk

whetstone-shim-check.name: Whetstone: shim check
whetstone-shim-check.description: Finds where else each actionable finding's defect class occurs and decides between a local fix, a class fix, or a fix simpler than the reviewer suggested.
whetstone-shim-check.author: Kirill Andriychuk

whetstone-triage.name: Whetstone: triage
whetstone-triage.description: Evidence gathering and result collection for deciding, with a decision model, whether each blocking finding is bikeshedding.
whetstone-triage.author: Kirill Andriychuk
